posts.title: Google Ads Cost Per Lead for Clinics in India (2026 Guide)
posts.excerpt: What Indian clinic owners should expect to pay per enquiry on Google Ads — and how to cut waste without killing volume.
posts.author: DisplayAvenue
body: Clinic owners across Mumbai, Delhi NCR, and Bengaluru ask the same question: how much should a Google Ads lead cost?

In 2026, most multi-specialty and dental clinics we work with see qualified enquiry costs between ₹180 and ₹650 depending on city competition, offer clarity, and landing-page speed. Cosmetic and implant campaigns usually sit higher.

Cost per lead is not the goal. Cost per booked appointment is. Track phone calls, WhatsApp clicks, and form fills separately — then filter tyre-kickers with a clear offer (free consult window, package price range, location).

Three fixes that usually drop CPL in 14 days: (1) tighten geo radius and exclude students/job-seekers with negatives, (2) send traffic to a one-offer landing page instead of the homepage, (3) reply on WhatsApp within 5 minutes.
DisplayAvenue builds search + call campaigns with conversion tracking so you see real appointments, not vanity clicks. Want a free clinic ads plan? Use our Strategy Maker or WhatsApp 9222 122333.

posts.title: Local SEO for Mumbai SMEs: Win the Google Maps Pack
posts.excerpt: A plain-English Local SEO playbook for shops, clinics, and service businesses that want more Maps calls and walk-ins.
posts.author: DisplayAvenue
body: If your customers search “near me”, Local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) matter more than a long blog.
Complete every GBP field: categories, services, products, hours, and photos taken at your real location. Name, address, phone must match your website footer exactly.
Post weekly updates (offers, new work, team notes). Ask for reviews after delivery with a simple WhatsApp script. Reply to every review.
Build one city × service page for your main offer (example: dental clinic in Mira Road). Link it from your homepage and GBP website button.
DisplayAvenue’s Local SEO score tool and citation checklist help you see gaps fast. Pair Maps with light Google Ads if you need enquiries this month while organic rankings build.

posts.title: Meta Ads to WhatsApp: The Lead Funnel Indian SMEs Actually Close
posts.excerpt: Cheap Instagram leads are useless if nobody replies. Here’s the WhatsApp-first funnel that turns Meta Ads into sales conversations.
posts.author: DisplayAvenue
body: Meta Ads can fill your inbox overnight. The problem is response speed and lead quality — not the algorithm alone.
Use Instant Forms or Click-to-WhatsApp with 3–4 qualifying questions (budget band, city, timeline). Route hot leads to a pinned WhatsApp welcome message with your offer and next step.
Creative that works in India: before/after, price clarity, UGC-style phone video, and a direct CTA (“WhatsApp now for today’s slots”). Test 3 creatives weekly; kill losers in 48–72 hours.
Sales ops matter: assign an owner, reply in under 5 minutes during business hours, and tag leads (hot / warm / nurture).
